strengths_deep_dive: In FY2024, the foundation reported <cite id="3">$4,100,385 in revenue</cite> with financial figures showing a <cite id="3">95.6% program expense ratio</cite> [3]. This efficiency is bolstered by an overall <cite id="1">92/100 rating from Charity Navigator</cite> [1]. Additionally, the charity has maintained community operations since <cite id="2">1993</cite>, utilizing a cash-adjusted program ratio score based on <cite id="3">95.6% program expense</cite> [2, 3].
rich_narrative.summary: Founded in 1993, The Rahima Foundation provides food aid, educational support, and emergency financial assistance to local communities [2, 3]. In FY2024, the foundation managed <cite id="3">$4,100,385 in total revenue</cite> to deliver programs such as <cite id="2">soup kitchens and meat distribution</cite> [3]. The organization maintains a <cite id="1">95.6% program expense ratio</cite>, directing the vast majority of its budget to direct services [3]. However, the foundation currently holds <cite id="1">65.0 months of operating reserves</cite>, which is an unusually high reserve level for an organization that collects zakat [1, 2]. Overall, Charity Navigator awards the organization a <cite id="1">92/100 score</cite> for its financial health and governance practices [1].
